_comment: Mutation testing for organisation truth: the recipe and link-rule contracts every workstream codes against, the import engine (rows -> entities and relations, full vs delta), the linking engine (signals, scoring, candidate detection, the review overrides), the model proposal's heuristic fallback, the projection plugin, and the composed router. WHY THESE FILES: every failure is silent. A recipe validator one character too lenient lets a column that does not exist through to the import; a delta run that closes entities behaves like a full run and erases the organisation's history; a link scored one point too high attaches a project owner to the wrong account and the matrix then shows that person's access under a project they never owned. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling API configs, so SQL text is not mutated; real-SQL correctness stays the contract tests' job. SCOPE RULE: every new non-test .js under src/orgtruth/ must be added to `mutate` here (mutationScope.guard.test.js matches paths exactly, no globs), or be given a written reason in `mutationExclusions`. Run: cd app/api && npm run test:mutation:orgtruth. NOT YET MEASURED: ships with the MVP; `break` is absent until a first run measures a score.

mutationExclusions.src/orgtruth/http/gates.js: Declaration, not logic: the two gate arrays (permission + feature flag) every org-truth route reuses. Which permission guards which route is asserted by the route tests of each sub-router; there is no branch here to mutate.
